name: Tacos
intro: Charred salsa, corn, and lime on warm tortillas. Skirt steak, shrimp, or beans — the tortilla doesn't mind.
season_anchor: Sweet corn, cut from the cob

variations.context: The default. Seared hard, sliced thin across the grain, charred salsa.
Seared shrimp, peach and lime, a little jalapeño.
No meat. Warm beans, corn, salsa, lime.

finish: Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until they blister in spots, two per taco. Sear the steak in a smoking-hot pan, two or three minutes a side, rest it five, and slice across the grain — that's what makes skirt steak tender.
